contractFindings.contractFinding: The component receives a fixed mailto destination at its inspected call site; its href prop is not an arbitrary destination there.
The export action creates a browser Blob URL locally with URL.createObjectURL; it is not a remote URL supplied by an upstream record.
The consumer requests /api/admin/evidence/export, but the local source contains /api/evidence/export and no matching admin route was found; the candidate downloadUrl is not proven to be produced.
The export-history downloadUrl is a data field with no validated origin or located producer; retain as a source-contract gap rather than infer a legal destination.

The UI reads scheduled-report fileUrl values through /api/v2/analytics/scheduled-reports, for which no local route was found. The scheduled executor stores uploaded fileUrl values; sample history also contains storage.example.com values. Neither establishes an origin allowlist.
virtualMeetingUrl is nullable text consumed as a link; database text storage and the component mapping do not constrain protocol or host.
The export href is built from a fixed local CBA agreement export endpoint and serialized filters; the destination path is source-bounded.
CBA source baseUrl is persisted as text and validated with z.string().url(); this proves URL syntax only, not an allowed host or origin.
Claim attachment URLs are read from attachment metadata; the case-evidence API creates blob URLs and persists attachment metadata, without a stable-origin constraint.
Editable email block content is split on a delimiter and its URL segment is used as an anchor href; the content schema is string-only and has no destination policy.
link.url is supplied by the campaign analytics response; no destination constraint is established by the consumer or response interface.
frPath is derived from the current pathname and locale and remains a local path under the inspected source logic.
Lesson content.url is a string used as video, image, iframe, and download source; the destination host is not constrained.
Employer communication attachments expose a string url and render it directly; no producer-side destination policy was located.
Grievance and related-document consumers use fileUrl fields; the upload schema uses z.string().url() and persisted document fields are text. URL syntax/storage do not impose an allowed-host policy.

IncidentDetailView expects attachments as string[] while the endpoint delegates to generic CRUD for workplaceIncidents; the inspected schema uses photoUrls as JSON string[]. No mapping between those fields or URL-origin constraint was found.
The report viewer fetches /api/health-safety/inspections/{id}/report, for which no local route was found. Its photos field is string[] and no destination policy is established.
The scheduler fetches /api/health-safety/committee/meetings, for which no local route was found; minutesUrl is a free-form string field in the component contract.
ICRA ctaHref values are fixed route literals in recommendation, scoring, and tier definitions; the inspected value source is finite.
Knowledge-base sourceUrl is read from persisted records and exposed by the API; the text field/API read path do not establish allowed hosts or the writer contract.
Grievance timeline resource URLs are static local paths from the human-explainers definitions.
Insight article Markdown is rendered with anchor links; the renderer does not establish a URL policy, and article content origin is not established by this trace.
